    SELECT 
        cust.cust_city,
        t.calendar_year,
        SUM(s.amount_sold) as total_sales
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers cust ON s.cust_id = cust.cust_id
    JOIN countries c ON cust.country_id = c.country_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE c.country_id = 52790
      AND t.calendar_year IN (2019, 2020)
      AND t.calendar_quarter_number = 4
      AND s.promo_id = 999
    GROUP BY cust.cust_city, t.calendar_year
),
city_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        cust_city,
        calendar_year,
        SUM(total_sales) as city_total
    FROM city_sales
    GROUP BY cust_city, calendar_year
),
eligible_cities AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ct1.cust_city
    FROM city_totals ct1
    JOIN city_totals ct2 ON ct1.cust_city = ct2.cust_city
    WHERE ct1.calendar_year = 2019
      AND ct2.calendar_year = 2020
      AND ct2.city_total >= ct1.city_total * 1.2
